blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.
blocks.zh: 使用摄像头不足的AUV录像重建3D结构是不准确的,尽管不确定这是否是由于方法上的缺陷或捕捉系统的固有缺陷. 我们在同一个南极冰下AUV视频(Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream)上测试四个不同的重建模型: 经典特征匹配SfM, 不同光度电镀, 量子深度聚变, 以及一个无假质的Feed-forward基础模型. 所有四个都以不同的方式失败:几乎完全登记几乎没有产生任何结构,尽管有健康的光度测量指标,但输出几何断裂,持续覆盖的文物,以及不稳定的跨圆形尺度。 我们显示这四个都符合相同的捕捉制度,一个小型的相机-基线-对-场景-深度比. 经过我们的分析,我们提出一种检测系统,在几分钟内标出这种故障,而不是浪费的计算时数。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D reconstruction from under-ice AUV video is persistently unreliable: turbidity and backscatter flatten contrast, while the ice underside is often smooth and weakly textured [ 1 , 8 ] . Although mitigations exist, it remains unclear whether the residual failures reflect the shortcomings of any one method or a deeper limitation of the capture geometry itself. Slow-moving AUVs sampled at low frame rates produce near-converging camera trajectories with limited translation between viewpoints, unlike the wide-baseline, well-distributed views on which most reconstruction pipelines are designed and validated. In practice, researchers face large collections of such footage where reconstruction success is difficult to anticipate, and substantial compute is routinely spent on batches that converge to geometrically fragmented output, with the failure only apparent after the fact.
blocks.zh: 由低冰AUV视频出品的3D重建持续不可靠:相差多变和后向散射平坦对比,而下方的冰层往往平滑而纹理薄弱[1,8]. 尽管存在缓解措施,但仍不清楚剩余故障是否反映了任何一种方法的缺陷,还是捕获几何本身的更深的局限性. 以低帧速率取样的缓慢移动的AUV产生近相机轨迹,视距之间翻译有限,与设计并验证大多数重建管线的广基线不同,分布良好. 在实践中,研究人员面临大量收集这类镜头的情况,难以预料重建的成功,大量计算经常花在几何分解输出的批量上,而失败只在事后才明显。

blocks.en:
Prior work in this space has largely evaluated individual pipelines in isolation [ 11 , 5 , 13 ] , without asking whether failures across structurally
different methods share a common, measurable cause. This distinction matters: if
failure is method-specific, the fix is method-specific tuning; if failure is
geometric, the fix is a single early warning system that generalizes across
pipelines.
blocks.zh:
先前在这一空间的工作基本上对孤立的个别输油管进行了评估[11、5、13],但没有询问整个结构是否失灵。
不同方法有一个共同的、可衡量的原因。 这种区别很重要:
失败是方法特定的,固定是方法特定的调取;如果失败是
几何式,固定式是单一的预警系统,它可以泛指整个
输油管。

blocks.en: This work tests four structurally unrelated reconstruction approaches: classical feature-matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model – on the same under-ice AUV footage (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream, USAP-DC 601975 [ 15 ] ), and shows that all four fail for reasons traceable to the same capture regime. The main contributions of this work are: • identification of a single quantified geometric predictor: a narrow camera baseline-to-scene-depth ratio that explains the distinct failure modes of four structurally different reconstruction methods on the same footage, • a lightweight baseline-to-depth check, derived directly from foundation-model camera poses, that flags likely failure in minutes rather than hours, • a negative control against the competing hypothesis that reconstructability is predictable from image content, rather than capture geometry: a texture-usability score, tested against altimeter ground truth, did not hold up.
blocks.zh: 这部作品测试了四种结构上无关的重建方法:古典地物比对SfM,可分光度测定电镀,体积深度聚变,以及一种无活性饲料向前进的地基模型 — 在同一冰下AUV镜头(Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream, USAP-DC 601975 [15])上,并显示所有四个都以可追溯到同一捕捉系统的原因失败了. 这项工作的主要贡献是: 确定单一的可量化几何预测器:狭义相机基线-相机深度比,解释同一镜头上四种结构上不同的重建方法的不同故障模式 —— 直接取自地基模型相机的轻量级基线-相机深度检查,标记可能在分钟后而非小时后出现故障 —— 对相竞假设的可重建性从图像内容上可以预测,而不是捕捉几何的负面控制 : 纹理-可用性分数,根据高度地平面的真象进行测试,没有维持.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Classical Structure-from-Motion methods such as COLMAP [ 11 ] recover camera poses and sparse structure through incremental feature matching and bundle adjustment, with dense surfaces typically obtained through volumetric depth fusion into a signed-distance field [ 3 ] . While these pipelines are well validated for wide-baseline, well-distributed captures, their behavior under narrow-baseline, near-converging viewpoints remains comparatively unexplored. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 5 ] replaces explicit correspondence search with differentiable photometric optimization, achieving high-quality novel-view synthesis without directly guaranteeing geometric consistency, a limitation that underwater adaptations have had to address [ 16 ] . Feed-forward foundation models such as DUSt3R [ 14 ] and its more scalable successor VGGT [ 13 ] instead predict camera poses and dense point maps directly from images, avoiding iterative optimization but introducing a different failure mode: maintaining consistent scale and pose across inference chunks.
blocks.zh: COLMAP等经典结构-自动相机[11]通过增量特性匹配和捆绑调整来恢复相机外形和稀疏结构,而密集表面一般通过量子深度聚变得到到一个签名-相距相机场[3]. 虽然这些管线对于宽底线,分布良好的捕捉来说都得到了很好的验证,但是它们在窄底线下的行为,相近相近的观点仍然相对来说没有得到探讨. 3D高斯平板(3DGS) [5] 以可分光度优化取代了明确的函文搜索,在不直接保证几何一致性的情况下实现了高品质的小说-视野合成,这是水下适应必须解决的局限性 [16]. Feed-forward基础模型,如 DUST3R [14] 及其更可扩展的后继VGGT [13] 取而代之的是直接从图像中预测相机的外观和密集点图,避免了迭代优化,但引入了不同的故障模式:保持相容尺度并摆出跨推论块.

blocks.en: AUV-based seafloor mapping has similarly reported reconstruction gaps and weakly reconstructed regions caused by platform motion and uneven illumination [ 12 ] . Icefin-based surveys demonstrate the scientific value of under-ice observation [ 6 ] , but the reliability of 3D reconstruction from such footage remains largely unaddressed. A smaller body of work has explored predicting reconstruction quality before running a full pipeline, including models linking UAV image characteristics such as blur, exposure, and noise to point-cloud accuracy [ 7 ] , no-reference image-quality measures based on photogrammetric descriptors [ 10 ] , and preprocessing strategies for blurred or texture-poor imagery [ 4 ] . However, these approaches primarily assess 2D image quality rather than 3D capture geometry.
blocks.zh: 基于AUV的海底测绘同样报告了由平台运动和不均匀发光所引发的重建缺口和薄弱的重建区域[12]. 以冰毒为基础的调查表明,冰下观测的科学价值[6],但从这种镜头中进行3D重建的可靠性基本上仍未得到解决。 较小的一组工作探索了在运行整条管线之前预测重建质量,包括将无人驾驶飞行器图像特征,如模糊、暴露和噪声与指向云的精确度相连接的模型[7],基于摄影测量描述符的不参考图像质量测量,以及模糊或纹理差图像的预处理策略[4]. 然而,这些方法主要评估2D图像质量而不是3D捕获几何.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset and Capture Setup
blocks.zh: 3 数据集和抓取设置

blocks.en: We use video footage collected by the Icefin autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) during dive ICE03_037 in the Kamb Ice Stream, Antarctica , available through the U.S. Antarctic Program Data Center (USAP-DC 601975) [ 15 ] . The dataset consists of downward- and forward-facing HD and SD video recorded as the vehicle moved slowly through the subglacial ice channel. For reconstruction experiments, frames were sampled at 1–4 fps from the box1 and box6 video clips, providing sequences with varying amounts of usable ice-surface texture. The footage presents a challenging reconstruction setting because the vehicle moves slowly and predominantly toward the observed surface, producing short camera baselines relative to scene depth and near-converging viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们使用冰原自主水下飞行器(AUV)在南极洲坎布冰流(Kamb Ice Stream)下水时所收集的视频镜头,可通过美国南极方案数据中心(USAP-DC 601975)查阅[15]. 数据集由下行和前行的HD和SD视频组成,在车辆缓慢地通过下冰川冰道时录入. 对于重建实验,从盒式1和盒式6相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 镜头呈现出一个具有挑战性的重建环境,因为车辆缓慢地主要朝被观测到的地表移动,产生与场景深度和相近相距相近的相机基线.

blocks.en: 4 Convergent Failure Across Four Methods
blocks.zh: 4 四种方法的协同失败

blocks.en:
To test whether the reconstruction limitations were algorithm-specific, we evaluated
the same under-ice footage using four structurally different approaches. Despite
substantially different failure modes, all four are consistent with one capture regime: insufficient
camera baseline relative to scene depth.
blocks.zh:
为了测试重建的局限性是否是特定的算法,我们评估了
同样的冰下镜头 使用四个结构不同的方法。 虽然
失败模式大相径庭,这四个模式都符合一个捕获系统:
相机基线相对于场景深度。

blocks.en: 4.1 Classical SfM: Registration Without Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.1 传统SfM:不重建登记

blocks.en:
We first evaluated COLMAP [ 11 ] on a 1 fps sequence of 62 frames from the box6 clip; exhaustive matching registered only 2 of 62 images.
Increasing the sampling rate to 4 fps and using COLMAP’s sequential matcher with
loop closure substantially improved registration, with 247 of 248 frames
successfully registered. Registration rate, however, measures completeness
rather than reconstruction quality: the model contains only 817 points across
248 images ( 3.3 3.3 /image, versus 40.4 40.4 /image for box1 processed
identically), with a median track length of 4 4 , so most features persist across
only a handful of near-identical consecutive frames rather than being observed
from distinct viewpoints. Mean reprojection error is 0.76 0.76 px: the bundle
adjustment is well satisfied, but by a sparse set of correspondences that does
not constrain scene geometry. Denser sampling recovers registration without
recovering structure.

从不同的观点。 平均再预测错误为 0.76 0.76 px: 捆绑

不限制场景几何。 Denser 采样回收登记,不

blocks.en: 4.2 Photometric Splatting: Healthy Metrics, Broken Geometry
blocks.zh: 4.2 测光 平板:健康计量,断层几何

blocks.en: We next trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 5 ] using the COLMAP reconstruction, so 3DGS inherits COLMAP’s camera poses rather than constituting an independent pose estimate. The resulting model was applied on box6 and achieved a test PSNR of 24.75 after 30,000 iterations, suggesting that the model reproduced the training-view appearance effectively. However, this metric concealed severe geometric degradation. When the reconstruction was rendered from a free viewpoint outside the original camera trajectory, the scene contained elongated, needle-like Gaussians extending away from the observed surface. The result demonstrates that photometric agreement from a narrow range of viewpoints does not necessarily imply geometrically valid reconstruction: with insufficient baseline, degenerate geometry can reproduce the observed images without being constrained by meaningful multi-view triangulation.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们训练了3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS)[5], 由此而来的模式被应用到框6上,并在经过了30,000次迭代后实现了24.75的PSNR的测试,暗示该模型有效复制了训练-观外观. 然而,这一指标掩盖了严重的几何退化。 当重建从原始相机轨迹外的自由角度进行时,场景包含从被观测到的地表向外延伸的长长,针状高斯人. 结果显示,从狭义角度获得的光度协议并不一定意味着几何有效的重建:在基线不足的情况下,退化的几何可以复制所观测到的图像而不受有意义的多视图三角形的限制.

blocks.en: 4.3 Depth Fusion: Bounded by Real Overlap
blocks.zh: 4.3 深度融合:由真实重叠所包围

blocks.en: To test whether replacing photometric optimization with explicit depth fusion avoided the problem, we estimated per-frame depth with Depth Anything 3 (DA3) [ 9 ] in monocular mode, back-projected the estimates into the reconstructed camera coordinate system, and fused them volumetrically using a TSDF. An initial configuration produced almost no consolidation, since the truncation band was too narrow relative to the disagreement between depth maps. Widening the voxel size and truncation distance reduced the surface from 15.0 million to 667,000 vertices, a substantial consolidation, yet the characteristic fan-like silhouette remained. Monocular depth carries per-frame scale and shift ambiguity, which contributes to this disagreement independently of baseline; DA3’s pose-conditioned and multi-view modes would separate the two contributions, and we leave that comparison to future work.
blocks.zh: 为了测试用明显的深度聚变来取代光度优化是否避免了这个问题,我们用单相机模式下的深度Anything 3(DA3)[9]对每帧深度进行了估计,将估计值反向投射入了被重建的相机坐标系统,并用TSDF进行量子化. 最初的配置几乎没有产生任何合并,因为与深度图之间的分歧相比,截取带过于狭窄. 拓宽了花瓶体积和截取距离,使地表从1500万个至66.7万个顶点相去甚远,大大地巩固了,然而特色的扇形花序还保留了下来. 单体深度具有每个框架的尺度和变化的模糊性,这与基线无关,助长了这种分歧;DA3的姿势和多视角模式将区分两种贡献,我们把这种比较留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: 4.4 Foundation Models: Local Success, Global Failure
blocks.zh: 4.4 基金会模式:地方成功、全球失败

blocks.en: Finally, we evaluated VGGT [ 13 ] , which predicts camera poses and dense point maps directly from images without iterative feature matching or bundle adjustment. On the box6 frame sequence for which COLMAP initially registered only two images, VGGT produced valid local reconstructions for all 62 frames. Individual inference chunks showed coherent geometry, demonstrating that the model can extract useful local structure even when classical feature matching fails. However, independently processed chunks could not be reliably combined into a common reconstruction. Similarity alignment of adjacent chunks produced relative scale factors ranging from 0.43 to 1.73, rather than the approximately unit scale expected for consistent reconstructions. Increasing the overlap between chunks did not resolve this instability, indicating that the problem is not simply insufficient overlap redundancy but the lack of sufficient translational baseline to constrain relative scale.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们评价了VGGT [13],它从图像直接预测相机姿势和密集点地图,而没有迭代特征匹配或捆绑调整. 在COLMAP最初只注册了两个图像的框6帧序列上,VGGT为所有62帧制作有效的局部重建. 单个推论块显示了相通的几何图形,表明即使经典特征匹配失败,模型也能提取出有用的局部结构. 然而,独立处理的块块无法可靠地合并为共同的重建。 相邻块的相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 增加块之间的重叠并不能解决这种不稳定,表明问题不仅仅是重叠冗余不足,而且缺乏足够的翻译基线来限制相对规模。

blocks.en: 4.5 Camera-Pose Quality Control
blocks.zh: 4.5相机质量 控制权

blocks.en:
The different failure modes become consistent when considered in terms of the
recovered camera trajectory. Across the evaluated sequences, the maximum
camera-center translation within VGGT inference chunks was only approximately
1–12% of the scene depth, with most measurements below 10%
(Figure 2 c). This narrow baseline-to-depth ratio is therefore a useful diagnostic description of the capture regime associated with failure in our experiments: COLMAP recovers
few well-triangulated points, 3DGS can satisfy photometric observations using
degenerate geometry, depth fusion cannot force independently estimated surfaces
to agree, and VGGT cannot reliably determine a common scale across local
reconstructions.

blocks.en:
One confound should be noted. Icefin’s lighting is rigidly coupled to the
camera, so irradiance at a fixed surface point varies with range, violating the
static-illumination assumption all four pipelines share. This covaries with the
geometry we measure – forward-dominant motion drives both – and our data
cannot separate them, though VGGT’s scale drift is not readily explained by
illumination, since relative scale is fixed by triangulation. We therefore treat
baseline-to-depth as a proxy for the capture regime rather than an isolated
cause.

虽然VGGT的平面漂移并不容易解释,
发光,因为相对尺度是由三角化固定的. 因此,我们对待
基线至深度作为捕获制度的代名词,而不是孤立的
事业。

blocks.en: 5 A Pre-Flight Baseline-Depth Check
blocks.zh: 5 飞行前基线-深度检查

blocks.en:
Section 4 identified camera baseline-to-scene-depth ratio as a common failure-associated characteristic across the evaluated methods, computable from VGGT camera poses alone without dense reconstruction or ground truth. We therefore use the ratio as a practical diagnostic for the failure regime observed in our experiments, while leaving broader thresholds for future validation. Reconstruction failed throughout the full 1–12% range
observed on our footage, so we anchor only a red tier (below 7%, where failures
cluster densely) to evidence; the 7–12% yellow and ≥ \geq 12% green tiers are
untested extrapolations, not validated thresholds.Computing the ratio takes ∼ \sim 4 minutes (VGGT runtime), versus hours to discover the failure through COLMAP, 3DGS, or TSDF fusion. box6 (measured 1.5–10.4%
per chunk) falls in the red tier, consistent with its observed failure.

blocks.en:
Several limitations remain: evidence from a single dive, so the tier thresholds
are anchored to one platform and ice regime; a pinhole model throughout, though
Icefin’s flat port makes the imaging refractive; VGGT’s relative pose accuracy
unvalidated under near-axial motion; and altimeter data used only to test the
texture score, not to evaluate reconstruction accuracy metrically. We also lack
a positive control, footage that passes the check and reconstructs successfully.
blocks.zh:
仍有一些局限性: 单次下潜的证据,所以分级阈值
以一个平台和冰雪制度为依托。
Icefin 的平端端口使图像折射活性; VGGT 的相对显示精度
在近轴运动下未验证; 高度计数据仅用于测试
纹理分数,不用于对重建精度进行计量评价. 我们也没有
一个正面的控制, 镜头,通过检查和 重建成功。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Four structurally unrelated reconstruction methods – classical SfM, photometric
splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward model – fail on
the same under-ice AUV footage in four distinct ways, with all four experiments exhibiting a camera baseline of only 1–12% of scene depth. Because this is computable from feed-forward camera poses alone, it supports a pre-run check that flags this footage as unreconstructable in minutes rather than hours, though only the failure tier is anchored to evidence here. Our attempt to predict reconstructability from image content instead did not survive validation against altimeter ground truth – on this footage, the
binding constraint is where the camera went, not what it saw. Extending the check across more dives, and deploying it onboard during a survey
so that flagged geometry can be corrected while the vehicle is still in the
water, remains future work.
